name: sqs
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS SQS (Simple Queue Service) queue, provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this queue.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Queue name. For a FIFO queue (queue_type = Fifo) the platform appends the required ".fifo" suffix automatically. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the queue is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the queue is provisioned.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this queue to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: queue_type
attributes.description: Queue type: Standard (best-effort ordering, at-least-once delivery) or Fifo (strict ordering, exactly-once). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: visibility_timeout_seconds
attributes.description: Time (seconds, 0-43200) a message is hidden after a consumer receives it. Defaults to 30 when unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: message_retention_seconds
attributes.description: How long (seconds, 60-1209600) messages are retained. Defaults to 345600 (4 days) when unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: receive_message_wait_seconds
attributes.description: Long-poll wait time (seconds, 0-20) for ReceiveMessage. Defaults to 0 (short polling) when unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: maximum_message_size_bytes
attributes.description: Maximum message size in bytes (1024-262144). Defaults to 262144 (256 KiB) when unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: delay_seconds
attributes.description: Delivery delay for new messages (seconds, 0-900). Defaults to 0 when unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: content_based_deduplication
attributes.description: Enable content-based deduplication (FIFO queues only; ignored for Standard). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: encryption_mode
attributes.description: Server-side encryption mode: None (unencrypted), SseS3 (SQS-managed keys), or SseKms (AWS KMS). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: kms_master_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ID, ARN, or alias used when encryption_mode is SseKms. Defaults to alias/aws/sqs when SseKms and unset. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: kms_data_key_reuse_seconds
attributes.description: How long (seconds, 60-86400) SQS reuses a KMS data key before calling KMS again (SseKms only). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the queue at creation, as key/value pairs. Platform ownership tags are added automatically. Set only at creation (SQS has no tag-update API).

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Defaults to DirectApiCall for SQS.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the queue.

attributes.name: sqs_id
attributes.description: UUID of this SQS queue, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: queue_url
attributes.description: URL of the provisioned SQS queue (used for send/receive/delete operations).

attributes.name: queue_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned SQS queue.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the queue was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the queue was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
